description:
## Problem (ISS-004) — audit pre-done 2026-07-01; findings below are grep-verified, so this ticket is mostly execution
Config schema: src/config/types.ts (ReviewBridgeConfigSchema + ReviewStandardsSchema). Verified consumer status of every field:

**CONFIRMED NO-OP (fix these):**
- `review_standards.code_review.max_file_size` (types.ts:32) — ZERO consumers anywhere in src/. DECISION: remove from the schema. Chunking (max_chunk_tokens) superseded whatever it was meant to do. Removing is safe: Zod non-strict parsing ignores the key in existing user configs.
- `review_standards.precommit.auto_diff` (types.ts:36) — never read. The review_precommit/review_code tools use their OWN `auto_diff` arg with `.default(true)` (src/tools/review-precommit.ts:18, review-code.ts:26); the config field cannot influence anything. DECISION: wire it — the tool arg's effective default becomes the config value: change the Zod arg to `.optional()` (drop `.default(true)`) and apply `args.auto_diff ?? config.review_standards.precommit.auto_diff` in the handler (review_code keeps plain default true — the config field is precommit-scoped). CLI precommit command gets the same fallback. This requires the tools to receive the config (check registerReviewXTool signatures; server.ts has the config in scope).

**CONFIRMED CONSUMED (do not touch, list for the audit record):** provider, model, codex_path (codex.ts), reasoning_effort (codex.ts:144; gemini.ts:484 warns it's codex-only), timeout_seconds (codex.ts:181, gemini.ts:419), max_chunk_tokens (orchestrator.ts:288, :392), review_standards.plan_review.focus/.depth (orchestrator.ts:201-202), code_review.criteria/.require_tests (orchestrator.ts:274, :309/:325), precommit.block_on (orchestrator.ts:415, :430), project_context (orchestrator.ts:199+), copilot_instructions (server.ts:71), fallback (index.ts:44), mode (index.ts:44).

**Unknown-key handling:** loader (src/config/loader.ts) currently strips unrecognized keys silently (Zod default). DECISION: warn, don't reject — after a successful parse, diff Object.keys(raw) against the schema's top-level keys and console.error a `[codex-bridge] ignoring unrecognized config field(s): ...` line (stderr only; MCP-safe since stdio transport uses stdout). Do the same one level down for review_standards.*. Do NOT use .strict() (it throws and would break existing configs).

**Re-audit delta:** T-028 may have added config/inputs by the time this runs (e.g. per-call deliberate is an INPUT, not config — but verify nothing new landed in the schema). Re-run the grep sweep for any field added after 2026-07-01 before closing.

## Acceptance
(a) max_file_size gone from schema + no references remain; (b) precommit auto_diff:false in .reviewbridge.json actually disables auto-capture via MCP and CLI (test both); explicit arg still overrides config; (c) loader warning test: unknown top-level key + unknown review_standards key each produce one stderr line, config still loads; (d) field→consumer table pasted into the closing commit message; (e) full gate green. Resolve ISS-004.

## House rules
Mind L-001: Zod v4 nested defaults MUST use function form `.default(() => Schema.parse({}))` — the schema already does this; preserve it when editing. Config layer must NOT import from review layer (duplicate types at the boundary if needed). TDD; ESM .js suffixes; no `any`/`as`; no AI names in commits.
title: Config audit: wire up or reject no-op fields (ISS-004)
